text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day before the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: —Well then, I'll be rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Phew...! That was the last interview, right?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Today, we have one, two, three, four... five outlets!
To think the day would come where so many
would come to interview me...
choice_data_list: That's proof people are starting to take notice.
That's proof people are starting to pay attention to you.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed.
That's what I think, too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...By the way, Trainer, did you notice?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: That reporter was someone who came by once before.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: You know, back before my debutâ

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
My, how adorable! Could you be
an Umamusume who hasn't debuted yet?
To think there was such a lovely girl here...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Back then, you probably didn't even know my name... let alone that I even existed.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...You actually came to our room
to interview us today...?!"
choice_data_list: It really brings back memories, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
This is proof of the steps Trainer and I have taken together, bit by bit...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That's why... in tomorrow's Japan Cup,
I will definitely win.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: To make sure everything up until now wasn't in vain... and so that this challenge doesn't end tomorrow, I must...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Zenno Rob Roy burn with such fighting spirit,
I thought she had truly grown into a dependable Umamusume, but—
choice_data_list: Still, you don't have to carry it all by yourself.
Still, you don't have to carry it all by yourself.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uh—
choice_data_list: Because I consider myself fighting right alongside you, too.
Because I feel like I'm fighting alongside you, too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy.
However—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"We've spent all this time together, training together...
and spinning this story together, haven't we?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So... it's not just that we're 'pretending'
to fight together.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Um... I want you to say it with certainty...
that we are 'fighting together.'"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Is it no good?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...Let's do our best together tomorrow too!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the moment has finally arrived!
The paddock for the GⅠ Japan Cup, where the world's finest contenders gather, will begin shortly!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And the most-watched Umamusume is, of course,
Zenno Rob Roy, who declared her aim for the Autumn Senior Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text: Will she follow up her Tenno Sho (Autumn) victory with another stunning win and close in on an unprecedented feat—? We're all eagerly watching!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Here she comes, here she comes,
it's Zenno Rob Roy!!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roooy!!
I'm counting on another brilliant victory today!!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Achieve the Fall Senior Triple Crown!!
Show us what you've got—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOO!!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Their expectations... weigh heavily on my shoulders.
It feels as if the blood in my feet is turning cold.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Come to think of it, it's always been like this. I want to be the protagonist,
to be a hero, but I hate being in the spotlight.
I lacked... the courage to become what I wanted to be.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(The Japan Cup naturally won't be easy.
It's a fierce 2,400m turf battle at Tokyo Racecourse, inviting top-tier Umamusume from all over the world.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Even though it's on the same Tokyo racecourse, the distance is different from the Tenno Sho (Autumn)... Facing that final 525-meter straight with an exhausted body feels dizzingly long.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Therefore, it is said that only Umamusume possessing true ability can conquer it—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (—Even so!!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you so much for your cheers!!
Please look forward to what's to come, everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The valiant heroic saga
that I shall paint upon the turf!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Expectations are heavy, and the battle is fierce!
But I'm... making real progress.
Step by step, on the path to claiming what's so hard to attain!!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (And I have always—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Because I am not fighting alone.)
